test_harness.source:
import contextlib,io,json,sys,unittest
class R(unittest.TestResult):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.passed=[]
 def addSuccess(self,t): super().addSuccess(t); self.passed.append(t.id())
r=R()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()),contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()): unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests',pattern=sys.argv[1]).run(r)
print(json.dumps(dict(tests_run=r.testsRun,passed=len(r.passed),failed=len(r.failures),errors=len(r.errors),skipped=len(r.skipped),expected_failures=len(r.expectedFailures),unexpected_successes=len(r.unexpectedSuccesses),pass_ids=r.passed,skip_ids=[dict(id=t.id(),reason=s) for t,s in r.skipped],failure_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.failures],error_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.errors],successful=r.wasSuccessful())))
sys.exit(0 if r.wasSuccessful() else 1)
test_harness.output_policy: Raw stdout/stderr captured in memory only; never persisted. Only IDs, skip reasons and aggregate metrics retained.
